## 6. Three-Cone Drill

Exercise Objective: Improve coordination, balance, acceleration, and deceleration when changing directions rapidly

## Procedure

1. Begin in the Form Start position (-13) at the starting line (-35)
2. When ready, sprint forward to the cone and plant right foot to complete a 90° change of direction to the left
3. Sprint forward to the far side of the next cone; plant left foot to complete a 180° change of direction to the right
4. Sprint forward back to the second cone and plant left foot to complete a 90° change of direction to the right
5. Sprint past the first cone to finish
6. Complete this drill in the opposite direction as well (i.e., right turn around the first cone, etc.)
